extracted.name: One Pan Dish
extracted.description: Had friends over decided to make something to eat. This is a really large amount. Adjust to your serving size.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup Zesty robusto Italian dressing, drizzled all over
instruction_lines: Melt 4 sticks of butter in a big pan on 425 for 5 minutes. Then add onions and let cook 5 minutes. Mix the onions and add potatoes and sausage. Let cook 1 hr. If you use different potatoes 45 minutes.
Add sourkrat to the pan and top with the Italian dressing.
Cook an additional 15-20 minutes. Take out of oven and enjoy.
